title: CriterionRead
description: Output of `criterion read`, in the shape A12 stores criteria in. With a `<name>` argument: that one criterion entry, the same shape `criterion add` accepts (`schema criterion add`). With NO argument: the model's whole `documentUniquenessCriteria` member, empty when it declares none.

fields.description: (one) the criterion's fields as `{fullName}` entries, in order

errorMessage.description: (one) the error text as `{locale, text}` entries

documentUniquenessCriteria.description: (every) each stored entry in model order; pass an entry's `name` back as `criterion read <name>`, or the entry itself to `criterion add` on another model
